prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: square standalone app/plugin logo mark
Primary request: Create one polished original logo mark for “Codex Mem,” an open-source local memory plugin for Codex. The mark should be a compact C-like archive/open-page shape with a clearly retained inner tab or second layer that conveys remembered context.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with no box, no shadowed card, and no surrounding scene.
Subject: one centered, self-contained geometric symbol, a bold open C-shaped archive/page silhouette with a simple inset tab or folded second layer.
Style/medium: restrained contemporary brand mark, vector-friendly raster geometry, crisp edges, high contrast, near-black and monochrome only.
Composition/framing: square canvas, generous transparent margin, mark centered and balanced, legible at favicon or 24px scale, simple silhouette with no tiny details.
Lighting/mood: flat graphic treatment, no gradients, no photorealism, calm and trustworthy.
Color palette: near-black with at most one subtle dark-gray secondary layer; transparent background remains truly alpha.
Materials/textures: clean solid fills, precise smooth geometry, no texture.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: exactly one standalone symbol; retain visible negative space so it reads as a C/open page; include one simple inner tab/second layer to imply stored context; original design; preserve transparent alpha.
Avoid: OpenAI knot, Claude symbol, generic AI brain, robot, circuit network, database cylinder, literal memory chip, tiny detail, text, letters, slogan, watermark, mockup, presentation board, screenshot, colored background, white background, border, drop shadow, glow, bevel, 3D render, gradients, multiple variants.
